BEFORE YOU PICK YOUR PLACE

A few good
things to know.

How do I order?

Choose a city, pick your size and presentation, and add it to your cart. Then check out securely online. If a city shows “price by email,” send it as an email inquiry and we’ll confirm pricing, availability, and delivery or pickup before you pay.

Can I choose a frame?

Tell us whether you prefer an unframed print, oak, black, or white frame. Frame availability and the final price will be confirmed with your order. Product previews show the artwork. We’ll confirm your preferred frame with your order.

What sizes and prices are available?

Email hello@califrames.com for current sizes and pricing. Include your favorite cities and preferred frame so we can help you find the right fit.

Can I order more than one city?

Of course. Add as many cities as you like to Your picks, and send them together in one inquiry.
